name: bilibili
description: Unofficial bilibili client for Samsung TVs, driven entirely by the remote: QR sign-in with multiple accounts, continue-watching row, danmaku, search, live, up to 1080p H.265 (4K with premium). Installs on Tizen 3.0+; tested on Tizen 5.5 and 9.0, playback on older sets not confirmed yet. Updates itself. Talks to bilibili directly, no backend or proxy.
